mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at 64 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. Tonight, we will see an overnight low of 58 degrees with rain in the forecast. If you look to the sky at 8:25 PM, you might catch the ISS passing by for five minutes, rising in the northwest over Verona High School and heading toward the northeast near Home Depot, while the waxing crescent moon is overhead.

The City of Verona is inviting residents to stay connected through their digital newsletter. By subscribing on the city website, you can receive regular updates on city projects, department programs, and important announcements to stay engaged with local government news.

There is plenty happening around town today. Enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's or the Wisconsin Brewing Company, find your zen with yoga at Insight Wellness, support local vendors at the downtown farmer's market in Hometown Junction Park, or join the competitive trivia fun at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, the action continues with more trivia over at Hop Haus Brewing Company.

Looking back at our weekly report, on September 5, an officer investigated a series of reports where multiple vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields throughout several city streets. It appears to be related to a viral social media prank, and luckily, no property damage was reported.
While we know it is a local favorite, please be aware that the Verona Culver's is currently closed for a facility remodel. We look forward to their reopening.
